name: both-relays-fail
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B stops at 12 s (rerouted via D) and D stops at 22 s. No path exists: the controller reports No available route. A cannot be told, because C's only neighbors are both dead; the announcement is retried a bounded number of times and ends unconfirmed.
